overview_description.description: Stake is a digital real estate investment platform that enables users to browse, invest in, and manage shares of residential and commercial properties and private real estate funds through a single online service. It offers fractional ownership of curated real estate assets and fund units, allowing investors to participate in rental income distribution and capital appreciation via automated digital transactions. The platform handles property sourcing, investment processing, compliance, and ongoing administration on behalf of investors, including managing operational tasks like leasing and maintenance. Investors can access opportunities, fund their wallets, monitor performance, and exit positions through structured windows provided within the platform’s interface. Stake works with fund managers to select assets and supports investment across multiple markets through its digital portal.
